subject: BCP attestation & supplemental artefacts for SOC/SIG review
messages:
From: Natalie Rivera <natalie.rivera@cobaltbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops-security@cobaltbank.com
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: supplemental BCP artefacts for SIG review

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Cobalt's InfoSec team is cataloguing artefacts for the SIG evaluation and we need a few supplemental items to close our checklist. Specifically: 

- A short snapshot of Redwood's DR runbook that shows the warm-cache failover steps and estimated time windows (we'll use this to validate RTO).
- A CSV export of recent RTO/RPO test timestamps (last 12 months) with the measured recovery times or a note if a test was table-top only.
- A mapping document correlating SIG control IDs to the artefacts you've provided in the portal (helps our reviewer navigate).

Can you provide these by EOD Tuesday 11/2? If any of this is already in the SIG bundle, point us to the link and we'll check.

Appreciate it,
Natalie

Natalie Rivera
Senior Information Security Analyst
Cobalt Bank
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Natalie Rivera <natalie.rivera@cobaltbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: supplemental BCP artefacts for SIG review

Hi Natalie —

Thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick notes:

- I'll attach a runbook snapshot (redwood_dr_runbook_snapshot_20271028.pdf) showing the warm-cache warm-to-standby steps and the playbook owner contacts. It includes the checklist used during a live failover.
- Ben is pulling the RTO/RPO extraction CSV from the ops archive; that will show live failover averages and table-top markers.
- Marcus will assemble a brief SIG artefact index (mapping) that points to the specific files in our shared folder and the control IDs.

If anything ends up being restricted for SOC2/SIG public consumption we'll flag it, but our intent is to give you the testing timestamps and clear mapping. Expect the first batch today and the remainder by COB Mon/early Tue.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_dr_runbook_snapshot_20271028.pdf (pdf, 340KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Natalie Rivera <natalie.rivera@cobaltbank.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RTO/RPO export and clarifications

Natalie / Vanessa —

Attached is the CSV export (rto_rpo_extraction_20271027.csv). A few points to make the reviewer life easier:

- Column notes: test_id, date_utc, region, failover_type (live/tabletop), rto_seconds, rpo_seconds, notes.
- Live failovers are tagged with failover_type=live. Table-top exercises have measured timestamps where available; otherwise we mark rto_seconds as "tabletop" in the notes column.
- For warm-cache scenarios the operational target is 5–7 minutes RTO for small cache-only services and up to 20 minutes for full-service restore depending on data warmup; the CSV shows observed medians.

I'm copying Marcus for the SIG mapping; Marcus, the mapping workbook should reference the SIG control keys (SIG v2026) and include a column with the internal artifact filename + Drive link.

Ben Carter
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachments: rto_rpo_extraction_20271027.csv (csv, 18KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Natalie Rivera <natalie.rivera@cobaltbank.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: SIG artefact index (initial draft)

Hi Natalie —

I've put together an initial SIG artefact index (sig_artifact_index.xlsx) that maps our documents to the SIG control set (v2026). Highlights:

- Tab "DR" includes: runbook snapshot (redwood_dr_runbook_snapshot_20271028.pdf), RTO/RPO CSV, and a short appendix describing cache-warm strategies.
- Tab "Access" references account access logs (redacted links) — note those require NDAs for full export; we included summary extracts.
- Each row has: control_id, artifact_name, artifact_summary, link_to_drive, redaction_note.

Two asks from our side: 1) confirm if you want the raw log extracts redacted more conservatively, and 2) whether the reviewer needs an executive summary to include measurable SLAs (we can draft a 1-pager).

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Technical Program Manager, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sig_artifact_index.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)
From: Natalie Rivera <natalie.rivera@cobaltbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BCP attestation & supplemental artefacts for SIG review

Vanessa / team —

Received the runbook snapshot and CSV. The SIG reviewer confirmed the mapping format is helpful but asked for one additional item: a short extract showing the last warm-cache activation trace (log excerpt) with timestamps for a single representative recovery event (redacted PII fine). This is only to validate the sequence and timing.

Could you provide a 1–2 page trace excerpt (PDF or text) by EOD today? Also helpful if you include a one-line callout to the column in the CSV that corresponds to the event.

We'll treat raw logs as confidential — the reviewer is internal to our vendor assurance team.

Thanks —
Natalie
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Natalie Rivera <natalie.rivera@cobaltbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BCP attestation & supplemental artefacts for SIG review

Natalie —

Thanks, we can do that. Attached is a representative trace excerpt (warm_cache_activation_trace_20271012.pdf) showing the sequence (cache flush, failover init, kv-warm, endpoint readiness) with timestamps and a one-line pointer: see test_id=20271012-live-07 in the CSV.

I've also added a one-page executive summary that calls out median/95th RTO for warm-cache scenarios. If you need anything else, loop us in.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: warm_cache_activation_trace_20271012.pdf (pdf, 24KB); executive_summary_rto_warmcache.pdf (pdf, 6KB)
